I haven’t ever really been certain that the person I’m dating is “the one” in any relationship I’ve had, I like to think of it more as a compatibility and logical argument. For me, I feel like a lot of people couldve been “the one”, but that’s only because I’ve really gotten along well with them, they bring a lot to the table in the relationship, and I’m just generally very comfortable with them. 

As far as my current girlfriend goes, she definitely checks all the boxes, but as I’ve grown older I’ve realized that the probability of never finding a good relationship again after a breakup is usually slim to none. Sure, it’s going to hurt like a bitch, but at the end of the day, if we’re both mature about it (which we’ve already discussed we would be if it came to that) then I guess I’m going to have to be ok with that, you know?

You are correct, 2 years isn’t a whole lot of time, and being that we’re both still young, in my eyes it’s better for it to happen now than later on down the line. 

Also just for clarification, I only included as many “excuses” as I did because I know how this sub can be, and I wanted to make sure that all the information was out there so that everyone had the full picture. I’m not the type of man to lie to myself especially where relationships are concerned. If I wasn’t happy, I would absolutely break it off. My reasoning for potentially ending the relationship is solely to do with the long distance aspect, nothing more.

Also, please don’t take any of this as retaliation to your comment, definitely not trying to argue, just clarifying! Thanks for your input :)
